caption_L2L3: The bar chart shows the overall number of enterprises in the manufacture of glass and glass products decreased in Poland, between the years 2008 and 2017. The number of enterprises decreased from over 1,200 in 2008 to just over 1,000 in 2017. Ther was a slight increase in 2010 and 2013, but overall the trend has shown a decrease.  The number of enterprises stayed the same in the years 2015,2016 and 2017.
